title: Prime-coefficient proper base change
statement:
Let $r$ be a prime number and $\mathbf F_r=\mathbf Z/r\mathbf Z$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] (separated, of finite type and universally closed; no finite-presentation hypothesis), let $g:Y'\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes and let

$$
 \square:\quad
 \begin{array}{ccc}
 X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
 f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
 Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
 \end{array}
$$

be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] completing $f$ and $g$. Let $F$ be a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant sheaf of rings $\underline{\mathbf F_r}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and write $F$ also for its underlying abelian sheaf, an object of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], regarded as a complex concentrated in degree $0$. Then the derived exchange morphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] of $\square$ at $F$,

$$
 \Ex_{\square,F}:g^{-1}Rf_*F\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf'_*g'^{-1}F ,
$$

is an isomorphism in the bounded below derived category $\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. (The derived functors are those of abelian sheaves; the statement is about this specified map, not an unnamed isomorphism between its source and target.)

proof.text: *The underlying abelian sheaf of $F$ is torsion.* For every object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$, $F(U)$ is a module over the ring $\underline{\mathbf F_r}(U)$ whose scalar multiplication extends the abelian group structure of $F(U)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The ring $\underline{\mathbf F_r}(U)$ receives a ring homomorphism from $\mathbf F_r$ (the constant presheaf maps to its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]), so $r\cdot1=0$ in it, and for $s\in F(U)$ we get $r s=(r\cdot1)s=0$. Hence multiplication by $r$ on the abelian sheaf $F$ is zero and its kernel is $F[r]=F$. Consequently $F[n]=F$ for every $n$ divisible by $r$. Now let $\iota_n:F[n]\to\varinjlim_mF[m]$ be the colimit injections and $c_F:\varinjlim_mF[m]\to F$ the canonical map of [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], so $c_F\iota_n$ is the inclusion $F[n]\hookrightarrow F$. Put $\psi=\iota_r:F=F[r]\to\varinjlim_mF[m]$. Then $c_F\psi=\mathrm{id}_F$. For every $n$, $F[n]\subseteq F[nr]=F$ and $F[r]=F[nr]$ as subsheaves, so the compatibility of the colimit injections gives $\iota_n=\iota_{nr}\circ(F[n]\hookrightarrow F[nr])$ and $\iota_r=\iota_{nr}$; hence $\psi c_F\iota_n=\iota_r\circ(F[n]\hookrightarrow F)=\iota_{nr}\circ(F[n]\hookrightarrow F[nr])=\iota_n$. By the universal property of the colimit $\psi c_F=\mathrm{id}$, so $c_F$ is an isomorphism and $F$ is a torsion abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf]. (Stacks makes the same observation in the proof of Lemma 0A4B: a sheaf annihilated by a prime $\ell$ is the case to which a torsion sheaf is reduced.)

proof.text: *Every proper morphism satisfies $\mathrm{PBC}$.* By [prop-weil-pbc-projective-line], for every scheme $S$ the projection $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ satisfies $\mathrm{PBC}$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-property]; this is exactly the hypothesis of [prop-weil-pbc-reduction-to-projective-line], which therefore gives $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ for every proper morphism $f$, in particular for our $f$. (The notion of proper morphism in that proposition, separated, of finite type and universally closed, is the one of [def-weil-proper-morphism]; no finite-presentation hypothesis enters: Stacks 095T assumes only that $f$ is proper, and the Chow lemma used in 0A4F, Limits, Lemma 0202, needs only a separated morphism of finite type over a quasi-compact quasi-separated base.) This is how Stacks proves Theorem 095T: by Lemma 0A4F it suffices to treat $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ for every $S$, which the rest of that proof does.

*Conclusion.* By definition [def-weil-pbc-property], $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ says that for every morphism $g:Y'\to Y$, every cartesian square $\square$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] completing $f$ and $g$, and every torsion abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ regarded as a complex in degree $0$, the derived exchange morphism $\Ex_{\square,F}:g^{-1}Rf_*F\to Rf'_*g'^{-1}F$ of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] is an isomorphism in $\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})$. Apply it to the given $g$, $\square$ and the underlying abelian sheaf of $F$, which is torsion by the first step: $\Ex_{\square,F}$ is an isomorphism, which is the assertion.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
Every proper morphism satisfies proper base change for sheaves of
$\mathbf F_\ell$-modules.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
The projective-line proposition supplies the sole geometric input required by
the S3 reduction. Finite morphisms, composition, and cancellation in that
reduction preserve the named S0 exchange map, so the resulting isomorphism is
the exchange map for the original proper morphism.

split_report.summary: Restated with every notion named: proper from def-weil-proper-morphism (replacing the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions), the cartesian square def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, sheaves of F_r-modules as modules over the constant sheaf of rings (def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf), and 'the specified map' made explicit as the derived exchange morphism of def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange at the underlying abelian sheaf in degree 0, an isomorphism in D+(Y'_et) of def-weil-pbc-derived-categories. Checked that 'no finite-presentation hypothesis' is right (Stacks 095T assumes only proper; Chow, Limits 0202, needs only separated of finite type). Proof in three steps following Stacks 095T/0A4F: (1) an F_r-module sheaf is killed by r, so F[r]=F and c_F is an isomorphism, i.e. F is torsion in the sense of def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf (written out, elementary); (2) prop-weil-pbc-projective-line gives the hypothesis of prop-weil-pbc-reduction-to-projective-line, hence PBC(f) for every proper f; (3) PBC(f) of def-weil-pbc-property applied to the square and the torsion sheaf F is exactly the assertion. proof_origin changed from the blueprint to Stacks. No new nodes. Mathlib has no etale direct images or proper base change; the source repository's Etale.hasTorsionBaseChange_of_isProper (not sorry-free) is the Lean of the general form and is reported as a candidate attachment.
